data.title: 伊卡洛斯 · 把断线的风筝放低一点
data.description: 伊卡洛斯捡到一只断线的风筝。线还勾在墙顶，她先托住木骨架，再够上去把打结的地方解开。阳光越过石墙，刚好照亮白粉战斗裙胸甲上扣合的锁扣。
data.location: 晒着午后太阳的旧石墙
data.action: 一手托住风筝骨架，另一手小心解下挂住的线
data.camera: 侧前方中景，胸甲、手和风筝同框
data.promptProse: Ikaros stands by a stone wall in her white-and-pink combat dress with its metal breastplate fastened. She supports the frame of a caught kite in one hand and lifts its tangled line off the top of the wall with her other hand. Afternoon sun catches the front clasp and the thin string.
data.animaCaption: One hand supports the kite’s frame and the other lifts the last loop of string clear of the wall.
